description:
## 1.10.5 (2026-11-08)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix comment posting failures and restore the display of newly posted comments during playback.
* **nicoid:** Prevent posted comments from appearing in the wrong playback session or being duplicated after refreshing.
* **nicoid:** Fix crashes and double-tap closing issues in popup playback.
* **nicoid:** Fix public mylist tabs showing "nicoid Re" instead of the actual mylist title.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Improve popup touch handling to prevent accidental closing and unwanted playback controls during dragging and resizing.
* **nicoid:** Refine double-tap recognition while preserving responsive closing and normal playback controls.
* **nicoid:** Preserve custom tab names and display long public mylist titles with automatic truncation.
* **nicoid:** Reduce redundant requests during comment posting and limit background comment retrieval rates to mitigate HTTP 429 errors.

patches.description: Morphe patch for nicoid. Supports the current NicoNico video service, dark mode, and Android 16, with additional feature improvements.

release_notes:
## 1.9.5 (2026-10-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix a crash when changing playback quality.
* **nicoid:** Fix popup player movement bounds.
* **nicoid:** Fix playback controls being positioned outside the visible area in tablet mode. ([#75](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/75))
* **nicoid:** Fix a crash when updating the displayed playback time.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Improve playback quality switching in normal and popup players. Switch between available video tracks without reloading the stream when supported, while preserving playback position and paused state.
* **nicoid:** Preserve the current playback position and playback state when a stream reload is required for a quality change.
* **nicoid:** Keep user selections synchronized across Nico Report tabs.
* **nicoid:** Improve Google Cast startup diagnostics, including playback request submission and results, to investigate playback remaining on “Preparing.” ([#70](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/70))
